description: This file declares the OpenMaxComponent class, which manages multimedia components, including buffer handling, port configuration, and tunneling for OpenMax components on Raspberry Pi 4. It provides interfaces for data input/output, port enabling, and event handling within the OpenMax framework.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponent
classes.description: Manages OpenMax multimedia components, handling buffers, ports, and tunneling.

methods.name: OpenMaxComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component with a name.

methods.name: SetOutputComponent
methods.description: Creates a tunnel to another OpenMax component's output.

methods.name: CloseTunnel
methods.description: Closes all tunnels to output components.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the component processing.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the component buffers.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the input buffer, returns bytes written or -1 on error.

methods.name: WriteEOS
methods.description: Writes an end-of-stream buffer, blocking until available.

methods.name: GetOutputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the next output buffer.

methods.name: DropOutputBuffer
methods.description: Releases an output buffer.

methods.name: OnErrorEvent
methods.description: Handles error events.

methods.name: OnEnableInputPort
methods.description: Callback for enabling input port, can be overridden.

methods.name: OnEnableOutputPort
methods.description: Callback for enabling output port, can be overridden.

methods.name: ~OpenMaxComponent
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: EnableOutputTunnelling

methods.name: GetUnusedInputBuffer

methods.name: OnFillBufferDone
methods.description: Callback when an output buffer is filled.
